## Online
Third-party credit cards: American Express, Discover, Mastercard, Visa.
PayPal.
SNAP EBT payment is accepted online. Cash EBT payment is not currently accepted.
## In store
Alipay is approved in authorized stores only.
Mobile Payments such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, or any contactless digital wallet.
Venmo cards are accepted in stores, but Venmo QR code payments are not accepted.
## Gift cards
Store gift cards can be used online and in stores.
Cashier's checks.
